title: Cruise Outbreaks Climbed As Ships Packed In Thousands
hook: Cruise ships pack illness into floating crowds of thousands.
closing: On a crowded cruise, handwashing can interrupt thousands of possible close contacts.
question: Would outbreaks change your cruise pick?

segments.say: Cruise outbreaks reached 20, continuing a three-year rise even as ships kept sailing.
Cruise norovirus caused 15 outbreaks, making it the leading recorded cause.
Cruise crowds can include 7,600 guests, creating thousands of close contacts for illness to cross.
